name: speakers
title: Speakers
description: A grid of person-cards for an event's speakers: name, role and organisation, one line on the talk, and the talk's title as a link to its slot in the agenda. No photo: each speaker gets a small marigold grown from their name, as decoration, in the card's round disc (an `avatar` option swaps it). An optional row of track checkboxes narrows the grid, with the choice kept in the address so a filtered view can be shared. Without JavaScript every speaker shows and the links work.

budget.reason: One small module: the track filter, the bloom avatar and the wiring, about 5 KB with its comments, and the Konkani words in two scripts (about 1.4 KB, Devanagari costs three bytes a letter; raised from 7168 on 7 October 2026). The cards are the person-card's own and the flower is the bloom's.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
